query:
SELECT c.nome, fc.totalServicos, fc.totalProdutos, fc.totalGeral, fc.qtdServicos
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc
JOIN colaboradores c ON fc.colaboradorId = c.id
WHERE fc.empresaSlug = 'barbiero-mascote' AND fc.mes = 5 AND fc.ano = 2026
ORDER BY fc.totalGeral DESC;
